text: Rabia Yilmaz is a seasoned Platform Engineer at CloudNova Solutions, bringing three years of expertise in cloud infrastructure and enterprise-scale systems. Her consulting work spans multiple industries, including fintech and healthcare, where she has designed scalable, resilient platforms that align with business objectives. A key focus of her role involves optimizing cloud costs across AWS and GCP environments, delivering annual savings of over 20% for clients through strategic resource allocation and automation. She has led the migration of critical applications to serverless architectures, enhancing scalability while reducing operational overhead. Rabia’s proficiency in Kubernetes has driven the deployment of high-availability microservices, with her architectures supporting millions of transactions monthly. She is also a vocal advocate for Infrastructure as Code, having architected Terraform pipelines that streamline multi-cloud operations and reduce deployment friction across teams. Her work with REST API design ensures seamless integration between systems, and her hands-on experience with Python and PostgreSQL underpins data-driven decision-making in complex workflows. Rabia’s approach balances technical rigor with business acumen, making her a trusted partner in delivering cloud-native solutions that drive innovation.
